jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
About CareMonitor

CareMonitor is an award-winning Australian digital health company headquartered in Sydney. Our AI enabled platform powers Hospital in the Home, virtual care, remote patient monitoring, chronic disease management, perioperative care and health and wellness programs for hospitals, Primary Health Networks, health insurers and community care providers across Australia. The platform connects patients and multidisciplinary care teams through real-time device data, telehealth and secure communication. CareMonitor is ISO 27001 certified and a winner of the Australian Digital Health Agency Innovation Award.

The Role

As Implementation Manager, you'll own the journey from signed contract to live, successful deployment. You'll lead implementations of the CareMonitor platform across hospitals, PHNs, insurers and community providers, scoping clinical and operational workflows, configuring care programs, coordinating integrations, training clinicians and care coordinators, and ensuring each client realises value quickly. You'll be the bridge between our clients' clinical teams and our product and engineering teams .

What You'll Do

• Lead end-to-end implementations: project planning, stakeholder management, go-live and handover to customer success.
• Run discovery workshops with clinicians, care coordinators and executives to map current workflows and design future-state models of care on the platform.
• Configure care programs, monitoring protocols, alerts, forms and dashboards to match each client's clinical requirements.
• Coordinate technical workstreams including EMR/practice-management integrations, device provisioning and data flows, working with engineering and client IT teams.
• Design and deliver training for clinical and administrative users; build adoption and change-management plans.
• Manage multiple concurrent projects, keeping scope, timelines, risks and client expectations under control.
• Track post-go-live adoption and clinical outcomes; identify expansion opportunities and feed client insights back into the product roadmap.
• Develop repeatable implementation playbooks, templates and documentation as we scale.

About You

• 3+ years implementing or project-managing health technology solutions (digital health, EMR, telehealth, RPM or similar SaaS).
• Understanding of Australian healthcare settings: hospitals, primary care, PHNs, aged/community care, and how care team’s work.
• Strong project management skills; comfortable running multiple deployments with clinical and executive stakeholders.
• Confident translating between clinical users and technical teams; familiarity with healthcare integrations (HL7/FHIR, practice management systems) is a plus.
• Excellent communicator and trainer: you can make software feel simple to a busy nurse or GP.
• Self-directed and organised; thrives working remotely in a fast-moving scale-up.
• Bonus: clinical background (nursing, allied health) or experience with change management in health services.

What We Offer

• Fully remote role anywhere in Australia, with travel to client sites as needed.
• Real impact on patient care at national scale, with marquee healthcare clients.
• A collaborative, mission-driven team at an award-winning health-tech scale-up.
• Competitive salary and career growth as our implementation function scales.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Natural Gas Projects
jobs.description:
We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016.  We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About This Role

As part of Intersect’s project delivery organization, you’ll lead the execution of critical power generation and energy infrastructure projects that support the convergence of electrification, digitalization, and decarbonization. Acting as the owner’s representative throughout the project lifecycle, you’ll guide complex projects from development through commissioning and commercial operation while partnering closely with engineering, construction, commercial, operations, and executive leadership teams.

You’ll oversee the successful delivery of natural gas-fired power generation facilities and related infrastructure, including reciprocating engine plants, gas turbine facilities, HV switchyards, substations, battery energy storage systems (BESS), generation assets, and large-scale data center power infrastructure. Success requires strong technical judgment, disciplined project execution, and the ability to align diverse stakeholders around safety, quality, schedule, budget, and long-term value creation.

This role is planned to start as soon as practical based on project requirements. A training and onboarding period of approximately two weeks is anticipated, with the expectation that the successful candidate will contribute immediately, become actively engaged during the first week, and achieve full organizational integration within the first two months.

Team Overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect’s mission to accelerate the clean energy transition through the development and execution of large-scale energy infrastructure projects. By bringing together expertise across development, engineering, construction, commercial operations, and asset management, the team delivers the integrated infrastructure required to support a more reliable, scalable, and sustainable energy future.

Joining this team provides the opportunity to work on highly visible projects with significant industry impact while collaborating alongside experienced professionals who are shaping the next generation of energy infrastructure. The team values accountability, innovation, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnership, creating an environment where individuals can grow professionally while contributing to meaningful outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Lead Complex Project Execution

Develop and execute comprehensive project plans, including scope definition, execution strategy, resource planning, governance structures, and delivery objectives.

Lead natural gas-fired power generation projects from development through commissioning and commercial operation.

Drive project performance against key objectives related to safety, quality, schedule, budget, and operational readiness.

Facilitate project closeout activities, lessons learned, commissioning support, and successful turnover to operations teams.

Manage EPC and External Partner Performance

Serve as the primary owner’s representative and point of contact for EPC contractors, consultants, utilities, equipment vendors, and key stakeholders.

Oversee contractor performance, contract compliance, commercial negotiations, change management activities, and claims resolution.

Review and approve construction strategies, procurement plans, and execution methodologies.

Build productive relationships across complex stakeholder groups to support successful project outcomes.

Drive Project Controls and Risk Management

Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, risk registers, and reporting frameworks.

Implement project controls processes that improve visibility into cost, schedule, and execution performance.

Lead risk identification, mitigation planning, and issue resolution activities throughout the project lifecycle.

Provide clear, actionable project updates to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

Deliver Technical Excellence

Partner with engineering teams to review and approve technical designs, engineering deliverables, vendor submittals, and construction approaches.

Support the integration of reciprocating engine facilities, gas turbine plants, HV substations and switchyards, utility interconnections, BESS assets, generation resources, and data center infrastructure.

Ensure technical solutions align with project objectives, operational requirements, and long-term asset performance expectations.

Drive quality assurance and quality control processes across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.

Champion Safety and Regulatory Compliance

Foster a culture of safety excellence across all project activities and stakeholder groups.

Conduct site inspections, audits, and field reviews to verify adherence to safety requirements, project specifications, and quality standards.

Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, environmental obligations, permitting requirements, and applicable energy-sector standards.

Support safe and compliant project execution while maintaining a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Build Alignment Across Teams

Partner with engineering, construction, commercial, operations, and executive leadership teams to drive decision-making and project success.

Facilitate collaboration across internal and external stakeholders to resolve challenges and maintain project momentum.

Promote accountability, transparency, and strong communication throughout project execution.

Help cultivate a high-performing environment centered on technical excellence, ownership, and long-term value creation.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering or design discipline.

10+ years of progressive experience in project execution, construction management, engineering management, or project leadership within power generation, energy infrastructure, oil & gas, utility, or heavy industrial sectors.

Demonstrated experience executing projects from either the Owner’s side or Contractor/EPC side through development, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

Direct experience supporting the construction and execution of natural gas-fired power generation projects.

Knowledge of quality assurance, commissioning, startup activities, and safety management systems.

Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and leadership skills.

A hands-on leadership style that balances strategic oversight with detailed execution and accountability.

Resilience, sound judgment, and composure when navigating competing priorities and complex stakeholder environments.

A commitment to collaboration, continuous learning, inclusion, and long-term value creation aligned with Intersect’s values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

Total Rewards

Total Compensation:
$188,500 - $205,400 (total compensation includes base salary + bonus in USD)

Equity:
Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company. 

Health & wellness:
100% premium coverage for you and your dependents on medical, dental, and vision

Time to recharge:
Unlimited PTO, plus two company-wide breaks (Fourth of July & end of year)

Family support:
Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, plus 6 additional weeks for birth parents; access to family planning and family care support through Carrot and Maven

Mental health:
Free access to Spring Health, including 5 free therapy and psychiatry sessions, plus a Headspace account for mindfulness and meditation through our physical health vendor, Wellhub+

Perks & extras:
$150 monthly food stipend, $150 monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet, pet insurance allowance, full home office setup, free access to UrbanSitter with $625 in quarterly company-paid credits, ActiveHero, and One Medical

All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling Intersect's commitment to equal employment opportunity. jobs.description:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this by empowering customers through the combination of the real and digital worlds, improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know a business thrives when its people are thriving, so we put our people first. Our global, diverse team will support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

The Siemens Project Management Office (PMO) is looking for a Project Manager - Customer Services (CS) to join our team in Electrification and Automation (EA). The Electrification & Automation business unit covers the entire spectrum for power distribution systems and service solutions. As a CS Project Manager, you will be responsible for the successful execution of projects, from project initiation through final closeout. You will work in a matrix style organization requiring excellent coordination skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Headquartered in Wendell, NC, the EA PMO executes a diverse portfolio of projects, and this position will be focused on service solutions within our Customer Services business. This role comes with ample opportunities for growth, reflective of Siemens mission to empower people with a growth mindset. As a customer facing team, we keep customer satisfaction at the forefront as we manage large projects in a fast-paced environment.

This position can be remote or based out of Wendell, NC

Project and System Types:

Project Types - installation and commissioning, turn key, design build, engineer, procure, construct (EPC), power system studies, maintenance outage testing and electrical system emergency response/disaster recovery, electrical retrofit managing teams of field service engineers as well as 3rd party suppliers, consultants and contractors

Product types: Photo Voltaic (Solar), Inverters, Low and medium voltage air insulated switchgear, medium voltage gas insulated switchgear and switches, low voltage panelboards and automatic transfer switches, air and liquid filled transformers, motor control centers, medium voltage contactors, integrated ehouse electrical solution systems, battery systems, electrical cable systems and busways, cable, connectors and supporting systems.

Primary Responsibilities:

Direct all phases of projects from inception through completion.
Ensure that we pre-identify and mitigate safety risks across on our service projects to guarantee safe completion of our service activities.
Responsible for the budget, schedule, quality, and performance of the assigned project(s).
Effectively communicate project expectations to team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion.
Provide regular updates to team, management, and PMO on work performed, plans, budget, and overall status.
Identify project problems and obtain solutions, such as allocation of resources or changing contractual specifications.
Manage customer expectations across the project cycle by regularly communicating our project milestone statuses, resource activities, and other service project related actions.
Prepare and/or work with application engineering team to develop change order quotations for additional service requests during the project.
Proactive and frequent communications with our Lead Field Service Representative working at the customer site.
Communicate to finance partners, scheduled completion, and revenue forecasting monthly for all assigned projects
Provide Lessons Learned feedback to our front end offers team to ensure we constantly are improving our offers and helping mitigate any unclear items for our customers.
Ensure all project and service requirements are identified, understood, and satisfied throughout the order life cycle.
Identify areas of risk within assigned projects and develop mitigation strategies
Define and develop requests for quote for 3rd party services as well as materials. Participate in vendor pricing and contract negotiations
Manage 3rd party vendors/suppliers monitoring and controlling agreed upon scope, schedule, budget
Work with internal commercial team to maintain client relationships
Collaboration with internal/external team members, vendors and/or project managers to develop site schedules
Review and understand project contractual obligations such as change order process, liquidated damages, claims processes, specification requirements, etc.
Develop project execution plans such as quality & testing plans, project schedule, risk registers and manpower plans
Identify and assign project resources ranging from engineering to field personnel
Monitor and controlling functions as it relates to continuously evaluating project performance vs budget/schedule.
Developing and implementing recovery plans to correct project performance issues.

You will win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

HS Diploma or equivalent
2+ years of experience in direct service project management
1+ years of experience in field service operations or environment (e.g., field service technician, engineer, project manager/specialist, etc.)
Able to travel 10-25% of the time on an annual basis
Applicants must be authorized for employment in the U.S. without the need for employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

A degree in engineering or construction management
Experience with MS Project
PMP certification – while not required immediately for this role, for those who do not have it already, obtaining PMP certification is required within 1 year of employment
Experience in specific industry related to service project e.g., field service, EPC projects, construction, energy, manufacturing
Strong leadership skills with experience in leading cross-functional project teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status, and issues to internal and external Customers.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Overview

Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company, is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as a Great Place to Work

Manage select external vendors (timelines, budgets, MSA/SOW documents, etc.) and integrate deliverables into program Gantt
Support development of Governance and Executive presentations
Provide support for the planning and preparation of documents to a quality standard required for Regulatory/Health Authority submissions
Contribute to establishment and refinement of best practices, processes and procedures

Basic Qualifications

BS plus 5+ years experience in pharmaceutical/biotech R&D environment, including 3+ years as PM or equivalent
Proven expertise in drug development and registration, including early and late-stage clinical, nonclinical, CMC development, and regulatory interactions, submissions/reviews globally
Highly motivated, proactive, detail-oriented and organized self-starter with strong communication, collaboration, interpersonal skills, and influence to accomplish work without formal authority and to ensure optimal team performance

Kia Hanga I Te Ao, E Ora Ai, E Tupu Ai, Te Tangata Me Te Kainga. At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

As a Senior Project Manager in our Delivery and Change Centre of Excellence, you’ll play a key role in managing one or multiple projects/streams involving significant business value and risk implications across divisions and business units.

You will promote the projects/streams at senior management level to enable value delivery, resolve technology and business issues, risks and dependencies, in line with business case and within defined accountabilities and constraints. : Auckland or Wellington

Permanent

37.5

Ka aha tō rā e kite ai? - What will your day look like?

The Senior Project Manager position is a transformational and outcome focused role with a broad range of responsibilities. Some of your day-to-day activities may include the below:

Leading the delivery of complex projects within scope, budget, and agreed timelines.
Developing business cases and supporting project funding and governance processes.
Managing project risks, issues, dependencies, procurement, and vendor relationships.
Building strong stakeholder relationships and delivering clear, effective project communications.
Driving collaboration across cross-functional teams to achieve successful outcomes.
Leading change initiatives and supporting business readiness in complex environments.
Monitoring project performance, reporting progress, and ensuring alignment with ANZ governance standards.
Identifying opportunities to improve delivery practices, processes, and project outcomes.
Coordinating resources to deliver high-quality outcomes and realise business benefits.
Coaching, mentoring, and supporting team members while fostering a collaborative and inclusive culture.

This position offers agility and innovation —you’ll be encouraged to bring your unique perspective and flair to make the role your own.

Ōu Pūkenga? - What will you bring?

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

Extensive Senior Project Management experience including substantial exposure to financial services compliance, risk management, or regulatory environments and delivering complex projects and business outcomes.
Demonstrated experience in working across a broad range of initiatives, from smaller scale projects to complex transformation programmes.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills across all levels of an organisation.
Proven ability to lead high-performing teams, providing direction, coaching, and mentoring.

Sound judgement, decision-making, and active listening skills.
Strong commercial acumen, including vendor management, procurement, and Statements of Work.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

He aha te take e uru ai koe ki a mātou? - So, why join us?

There's something special about being part of ANZ, you're part of a work whānau striving towards a common purpose: shaping a world where communities thrive. Our teams do this by helping people make the most of what they have, to transform ideas, hard work and ambition into reality.

Career development means different things to different people. It may simply mean developing a skill, broadening your experience by moving sideways or stretching yourself by moving to a different business. How you manage and develop your career is up to you. That's why we're committed to helping you do this by providing you with the support, tools and resources you need to take the next big step in your career, towards even bigger things with us in the future.

You are also an active member of the Global Boutique Architecture Team (B A T Community), a global architecture network that connects regional teams through weekly touchpoints and semi-annual in-person moments focused on learning, best-practice sharing, and alignment on global policies and procedures. The B A T Community works closely to ensure consistency, quality, and excellence across all CHANEL boutiques worldwide as all regions parnter with our global design architect, Peter Marino Architects (PMA).

Project & Program Management

Lead defined scopes of work independently across all project phases, including due diligence, design development, construction, cost management, openings, and after-care
Coordinate complex projects across standalone buildings, shopping malls, and historically protected sites with sophisticated interior concepts

Job Description:

RAPP Chicago is looking for a Technical Project Manager to join our award-winning Project Management team.

WHO WE ARE:

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As a global, next-generation precision marketing agency we leverage data, creativity, technology, and empathy to foster client growth. We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

HOW WE DO IT:

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help to create value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.

Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.

Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets

HOW WE DO IT:

At RAPP, we are fiercely focused on the individual and how we can create value from every individual’s experience with a brand. We do this across three capability areas: customer-centric consulting, creativity that inspires action and customer experience management.

Our data analysts know who that person is. Our strategists understand what they want. And our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to get it to them.

RAPP is an integral part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, comprising 4,000 creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 40 global markets.

YOUR ROLE:

This is a high profile and fast paced role within the Data and Technology arms of RAPP and involves managing the full lifecycle development of multiple projects simultaneously with the provision of leadership, direction and supervision to a number of project leaders and system engineers running independent projects and managing system changes. The type of projects you will be responsible for managing involves the development and implementation of large scale real-time marketing solutions and are highly driven by data and technology innovation.

Another key part of this role will involve being a business and technical liaison with a diverse range of functions with RAPP’s client, their agency partners and RAPP 3rd party suppliers. You will be charged with setting and reviewing objectives and coordinating technology implementation activities across projects along with leaders from the technology group. In addition, you’ll have commercial responsibility for your team and will be expected to provide accurate estimates, and measure these forecasts against actuals.

We are looking for someone who can understand and drive client requirements to ensure RAPP delivers excellent solutions both from a technical and operational perspective, someone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and manage the project through to delivery. You’re creative, solutions-driven, organized and have exceptional people skills.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Continuously monitor progress in terms of the status of the plan and the budget and report back to senior management and the client via weekly or other progress reporting and by organizing and managing status meetings
Develop full-scale integrated project plans and associated communications documents and effectively communicate project expectations to team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion and oversee tasks though completion
Maintain project timelines, documentation, risks, activities, and decisions reporting on these weekly.
Manage expectations of clients and project stakeholders/sponsors and build a level of respect and trust with clients
Set policies and procedures for projects and ensure projects are run according to them.
Estimate the resources and participants needed to achieve project goals and assign individual responsibilities and resolve resource conflicts within assigned resources
Facilitate documentation creation such as business requirements, technical architecture, and functional specifications and ensure technology solutions implemented to deliver best in class solutions for our clients
Conduct project postmortems and create recommendations report to identify successful and unsuccessful project elements and from this, develop best practices and tools for project execution and management

REQUIRED SKILLS:

PMP and/or SCRUM certification beneficial
Bachelors degree required
2-5 years relevant experience, tech environment is a must
Experience leading SCRUM meetings and sprint planning
Experience with JIRA or similar project management software
Ability to work with cross functional teams and lead a team of developers
Ability to estimate the level of effort a developer would need to complete a given task.
Ability to compentently write technical tickets for developers to work on.
The soft skills of gatekeeping members of an internal technical team from other teams and clients.
Be able to negotiate, coach, present and troubleshoot all the way through a project
Be agile and able to think on your feet – multi-tasking will comes naturally and have your finger on the pulse at all times across all projects
Solid understanding of SDLC and best practices for implementation
Solid understanding of and ability to create clear and comprehensive requirements documentation including usage of use cases or user stories.
Experience with stakeholder interview and requirement capture a must
Familiarity with cloud environments inclusive of Azure and AWS
Solid understanding of common cloud services.
Knowledge or familiarity of Python and JSON
Knowledge of data mining and database management, campaign management, APIs, encryption/hashing, and data security.
Knowldege of how to build and maintain a project schedule and timeline: Microsoft Project or Smartsheets.
Experience within all aspects of process development and execution – we’re particularly keen to see experience of delivering digital solutions through full-cycle web builds, ETL process experience and QA processes
Be a team leader and manager – with experience of growing and developing a team and helping get the best out of your colleagues
Have an understanding of web/software applications, application architecture, OS, functionality, intra/extranet and client/server architectures
The ability to demonstrate a comprehensive understanding in the areas of application programming, database and system design, digital design, information analysis, business requirements definition, analysis/modelling skills and database / data warehouse design
Knowledge or familiarity of campaign orchestration platforms or Pega Marketing tool is a plus
Experience working within a DoD controlled environment is a plus
Proven ability to rearrange work given new priorities
Good understanding of data security issues inclusive of PII storage and US requirements around compliance (ISO 27001) is a plus

RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.

The Global Trade Compliance team operates across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions in close collaboration with Husky’s Legal department. The team defines, implements, and continuously improves processes and policies to ensure compliance with global export control, sanctions, and customs regulations.

As the Global Trade Compliance Program Manager, you will report to the Director, Global Trade Compliance & Customs and serve as the program lead for enterprise-wide trade compliance initiatives. This role will focus on managing global compliance projects, optimizing processes, and ensuring the successful integration of trade compliance requirements into Husky’s systems.

You will partner with cross-functional teams—including Supply Chain, Engineering, IT, Finance, and Sales—to strengthen Husky’s global trade compliance framework, enhance operational efficiency, and reduce compliance risk across all regions.

Key Responsibilities

Program and Project Management

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of global trade compliance initiatives, including process optimization, technology integration, and system enhancements.

Manage the implementation of trade compliance modules within the ERP system to ensure alignment with global regulatory requirements.

Establish and maintain project governance, milestones, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms for trade compliance programs.

Coordinate global stakeholders to ensure timely completion of key deliverables and consistent global deployment of compliance practices.

Regulatory Compliance and Oversight

Stay current on international trade laws, import regulations/tariffs, export control regulations, and sanctions programs applicable to Husky’s business activities.

Translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable business processes and internal controls.

Collaborate with Engineering and Legal teams to establish export control measures and export authorization processes globally.

Monitor the effectiveness of trade compliance procedures and implement corrective actions as needed.

Classification, Licensing, and Documentation

Lead efforts to standardize global product classification processes, including export control, HTS, and country-of-origin determinations.

Develop and maintain processes for end-use/end-user certifications, license applications, and transaction due diligence.

Ensure accuracy and consistency in trade data, documentation, and system configurations supporting export and customs compliance.

Risk Management and Continuous Improvement

Conduct global risk assessments and audits to evaluate compliance performance and identify improvement opportunities.

Develop risk mitigation strategies to prevent export control or import customs violations.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging digital tools and automation to enhance compliance monitoring and reporting.

Support internal investigations and voluntary disclosures, when applicable.

Training, Communication, and Stakeholder Engagement

Develop and deliver global training programs to increase awareness of export control, sanctions, and customs requirements.

Promote a culture of compliance through proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration.

Partner with IT, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure trade compliance considerations are embedded in business processes.

Provide input in communications with government authorities and external consultants regarding trade compliance projects and inquiries.

Required Experience & Education

10+ years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, covering export controls, customs, sanctions, and trade agreements.

Deep understanding of U.S., EU, and Canadian export control and sanctions laws, with additional experience in UK, Swiss, Chinese, and other jurisdictions considered an asset.

Proven track record in managing large-scale trade compliance or ERP integration projects within a multinational organization.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, International Business, Law, Supply Chain, or related discipline; PMP or other project management certification preferred.

Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to interpret complex regulations and translate them into practical business solutions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of influencing and engaging stakeholders across multiple levels and functions.

Demonstrated ability to lead change, manage competing priorities, and deliver results under tight deadlines in a global environment.

jobs.title: IT Sr. Project Manager, Helen Diller Hospital
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior IT Project Manager will lead planning, coordination, and execution of IT workstreams supporting the Helen Diller Hospital project, a multi-year, large-scale capital initiative. This role will oversee technology program delivery across clinical applications, infrastructure, and end-user systems to ensure alignment with hospital operational readiness and strategic goals. Responsibilities include managing scope, schedule, budget, risks, and dependencies across diverse stakeholder groups; facilitating decision-making between IT, construction, and clinical leadership; and ensuring regulatory, security, and patient safety requirements are met. The Senior IT Project Manager will serve as a primary liaison between IT leadership, project governance, and vendor partners, providing executive-level visibility into progress, issues, and mitigation strategies.

As a Senior IT Project Manager for the Helen Diller Hospital project, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of healthcare delivery. This position is responsible for planning and implementing fully integrated IT solutions to support the new Helen Diller Hospital at Parnassus Heights. The work involves implementing IT services that are future-ready, adaptable to emerging technologies, and capable of supporting smooth transitions over time.

This role requires a deep understanding of institutional, medical center, and systemwide priorities, as well as long-term strategic goals. You will lead and manage complex IT workstreams with broad institutional impact, requiring sophisticated analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and innovative problem-solving.

As a recognized subject matter expert and senior leader in project management, you will influence methods, standards, and best practices across the organization. Your expertise will not only guide the Helen Diller Hospital initiative but will also shape how large-scale IT projects are managed across the campus, medical center, and broader UC system.

The new 15-story, 875,000 gross-square-foot (GSF) hospital will enable UCSF to provide much-needed capacity for additional acute, emergency and intensive care beds, meet the state’s seismic requirements, and provide an optimal healing environment that addresses social, psychological, spiritual, and behavioral components of health in one place. The holistic focus on the needs of patients reflects UCSF’s integrated research, education and care delivery mission at Parnassus Heights. The new hospital will incorporate the latest innovations in technology and equipment for advanced complex care and bridge scientific research discoveries from bench to bedside leading to accelerated innovative treatments and therapies to benefit patients.

UCSF Health is a growing regional health system that includes UCSF Medical Center, the top-ranked hospital in California and among the top five nationally, according to U.S. News & World Report. The new hospital will be embedded within a campus that includes leading clinicians and scientists focused on translating discoveries into treatments and cures. UCSF Helen Diller Medical Center is part of a planned broader revitalization of the Parnassus Heights campus that also will modernize facilities supporting our research and education priorities.

As a key member of the multi-disciplinary UCSF Health IT team, you will be at the front line of creating the next generation of healthcare delivery. To ensure a successful opening, the UCSF HDH IT Working Committee will define and prioritize opportunities to test new technologies and workflows that can be deployed earlier in existing hospitals. Through this continuous learning approach, you will help prepare our frontline staff and operations, and design for patients and families a seamless care experience between UCSF Health and partner care facilities, as well as pre- and post-procedure at home.

Department Overview

UCSF Health IT is responsible for all aspects of clinical and business software applications, informatics, and AI for UCSF Health hospitals, practices, affiliates, and community partners. This includes the Electronic Health Record (APeX), which supports the clinical, revenue cycle, and clinical operational functions of the health system and its affiliates, and approximately 95 other software applications involved in patient care and operations.

“People First: Patients are healthier and families happier with clinical systems to support them. exhibits bias-to-action, and avoids analysis-paralysis

Finds practical solutions to hard problems, suggests better approaches and new ideas that prove useful, and stays nimble by minimizing complexity and finding time to simplify.

10+ years of relevant experience

Working knowledge of technology-related initiatives and an understanding of impact to the organization of such initiatives.
Demonstrated capacity to anticipate obstacles and plan for contingencies. Demonstrated attention to detail. Demonstrated ability to determine relevance and prioritize tasks.

Broad knowledge of technology-related initiatives and an understanding of impact to the organization of such initiatives.
Proven leadership ability. Effective problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to put forth persuasive arguments.
Demonstrated competency in selecting and implementing project management methods and techniques. Effective skill at tracking effort and project progress. Demonstrated strong conceptual and planning skills to analyze projects of broad and diverse scope. Demonstrated expert organization and project management skills. Understands the cost impact of projects, project tracking tools, and metrics.
Experienced mentor and leader of teams with experience leading a team of technology professionals.
Advanced knowledge of all aspects of computing and communications including hardware infrastructure, networking, software, operations and disaster recovery.
Has a thorough understanding of how programs relate to other business strategies and initiatives. Demonstrated ability to integrate critical information across disciplines.
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with executive-level management on a regular basis.

Establish and maintain project governance, milestones, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms for trade compliance programs.
Coordinate global stakeholders to ensure timely completion of key deliverables and consistent global deployment of compliance practices.

Regulatory Compliance and Oversight

Stay current on international trade laws, import regulations/tariffs, export control regulations, and sanctions programs applicable to Husky’s business activities.
Translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable business processes and internal controls.
Collaborate with Engineering and Legal teams to establish export control measures and export authorization processes globally.
Monitor the effectiveness of trade compliance procedures and implement corrective actions as needed.

Develop and maintain processes for end-use/end-user certifications, license applications, and transaction due diligence.
Ensure accuracy and consistency in trade data, documentation, and system configurations supporting export and customs compliance.

Develop risk mitigation strategies to prevent export control or import customs violations.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging digital tools and automation to enhance compliance monitoring and reporting.
Support internal investigations and voluntary disclosures, when applicable.

Develop and deliver global training programs to increase awareness of export control, sanctions, and customs requirements.
Promote a culture of compliance through proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration.
Partner with IT, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure trade compliance considerations are embedded in business processes.
Provide input in communications with government authorities and external consultants regarding trade compliance projects and inquiries.

10+ years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, covering export controls, customs, sanctions, and trade agreements.
Deep understanding of U.S., EU, and Canadian export control and sanctions laws, with additional experience in UK, Swiss, Chinese, and other jurisdictions considered an asset.
Proven track record in managing large-scale trade compliance or ERP integration projects within a multinational organization.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, International Business, Law, Supply Chain, or related discipline; PMP or other project management certification preferred.
Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to interpret complex regulations and translate them into practical business solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of influencing and engaging stakeholders across multiple levels and functions.
Demonstrated ability to lead change, manage competing priorities, and deliver results under tight deadlines in a global environment.

jobs.title: Business Analyst – Data & Insights | HPX | Sydney
jobs.description:
An exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing business with an amazing culture. We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Data Insights function, sitting close to the business and acting as the trusted, go-to contact for our partners and teams on all things reporting. You will build a deep understanding of how different parts of the business work and what they need from data, and you will be the person who makes sure they can get it — whether that means showing them how to run the reports, handling ad-hoc data queries, or scoping out what a new dashboard needs to do.

The Role

Reporting to our Data Science Senior Manager and working alongside our Senior Data Analyst, you will be the human face of the Data Insights function for the business. Where the rest of the team is focused on building and maintaining our data platform and dashboards, you will be focused on the people using them: understanding what partners and business teams are trying to achieve, helping them get value from the reporting we already have, and making sure new requests are properly understood and documented.

Day to day, this means proactively teaching people how to find, access and run existing reports themselves, through training sessions, quick how-to guides, or simply sitting with someone and walking them through it. It also means handling ad-hoc data queries and investigations. Over time, you will build the relationships and reputation that make you the first call whenever someone in the business has a question about their data.

When a partner or business team wants something new – a new dashboard, a new view of existing data, a new way of tracking something – you will be the one who sits with them to work out what they actually need, not just what they first ask for. You will turn that into clear, well-documented requirements that our data team can build against, and stay involved through delivery to make sure the end result matches what was asked for.

We are moving away from Power BI toward python-based dashboards (Streamlit) running on Databricks. You don't need to be able to build in these tools, though if you have some python experience and want to get involved in building dashboards yourself, there will certainly be scope to do so. What matters most is that you can navigate and confidently talk through reports and dashboards from the end user's side, and that you understand enough about how our platform works to have an informed conversation with the data team about what's feasible and how long it might take.

This role is based in Sydney, where most of our partners are based, as it is important you can build in-person relationships with the business. We would also consider candidates based in Melbourne or Brisbane. Hybrid working arrangements are available.

About You

We are looking for someone who:

Has experience as a business analyst, reporting, data analyst or similar role
Has previous law firm experience, or similar professional services experience – this will be highly regarded
Builds relationships easily and enjoys being the go-to person for partners and business teams, including at a senior level
Genuinely enjoys teaching and training others, and can confidently run sessions or one-on-ones showing colleagues how to access and run reports
Can sit with a stakeholder, ask the right questions, and turn a loosely defined request into clear, well-documented requirements for a new report or dashboard
Is a clear, patient communicator, equally comfortable explaining a report to a partner and relaying a business requirement to the data team
Is proactive and curious, and enjoys spotting opportunities where better reporting, training or data access could help the business
Is highly organised, able to juggle multiple stakeholder requests at once without dropping the ball.

About Us

We have built a high-growth, people-centric business that maximises our 'people experience' (PX) to foster a vibrant culture, putting our people at the forefront of everything we do.

We are agile and flexible in our approach, with innovative state-of-the-art systems and technology that frees up our team from bureaucracy and administration. We actively develop a culture that supports employee health, wellness and development.

Put simply, we have created a work environment based on respect, trust, development, collaboration and innovation. This allows our people to grow and be the best version of themselves. In turn, this enables our people to do their best work, which ultimately makes our clients happy. This is a win-win-win.

We put our people's experience at the centre of everything we do.

What's In It For You

Be mentored in a supportive environment, with access to quality work and professional development opportunities.
A fun, collaborative and high-performing team environment with regular social events, training days and team retreats.
Flexible working arrangements.
A competitive remuneration package, including equity pursuant to the Group's ESS.
An extra week's leave, as part of our employee personal development programme.
Full-day birthday leave.

We prefer to work directly with candidates, if you are interested in this role, please click the 'Apply' button or contact the consultant, details below, for more information.

For more information on the HPX Group, please visit https://hpxgroup.com.au/ or follow us on LinkedIn here.

Agency submissions

jobs.title: Institutional Biosafety Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

We have an opening for an Institutional Biosafety Program Manager
to provide strategic and technical leadership for LLNL’s institutional biosafety program. In this role, you will manage the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of a comprehensive biosafety program supporting biological research, laboratory animal research, and related institutional review activities.

You will work closely with Environment, Safety and Health leadership, principal investigators, research teams, institutional committees, and the Department of Energy to ensure that biological research is conducted safely, securely, and in compliance with applicable federal, state, local, and Laboratory requirements.

This position is in the Occupational Safety, Health and Environmental Protection Department within the Environment, Safety and Health Directorate.

This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. The ability to work from home one or more days per week may be available after a probationary period.

You will

Manage and continuously improve LLNL’s institutional biosafety program, policies, procedures, and program documentation.
Provide expert technical guidance on biosafety, biosecurity, biological research risks, containment concepts, and laboratory operations.
Develop program strategies, priorities, performance objectives, and resource requirements aligned with Laboratory mission needs.
Lead risk assessments for new and ongoing biological research activities and support development of Biological Use Authorizations.
Oversee biosafety reviews involving biological agents and materials, including activities conducted at BSL-1 through BSL-3 and ABSL-1 through ABSL-3 containment levels.
Ensure compliance with applicable requirements and industry standards, including Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories, NIH Guidelines, OSHA standards, DOE requirements, and other applicable federal, state and local regulations.
Serve as the Institutional Biosafety Officer and participate as a voting member of the Institutional Biosafety Committee, Biological Review Committee, Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee and Institutional Review Entity.
Serve as an institutional technical liaison with DOE, the DOE Livermore Field Office, USDA, and other regulatory or oversight organizations.
Oversee biosafety audits, inspections, assessments, investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities.
Develop and maintain emergency response procedures for incidents involving biological agents and materials.
Oversee institutional biosafety training, including curriculum development, regulatory updates, delivery, and compliance tracking.
Establish and maintain data-driven performance measures, leading indicators, and program health metrics.
Compile, analyze, and communicate biosafety program information for leadership, oversight bodies, committees, and regulatory agencies.
Provide biosafety input into the planning, renovation, and design of biological research facilities.
Build collaborative relationships with principal investigators, researchers, line managers, staff, committees, and external stakeholders.
Benchmark biosafety practices with other DOE laboratories and research institutions.
Lead, mentor, and develop biosafety professionals and other program personnel, as assigned.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.
Masters degree in biology, microbiology, molecular biology, virology, immunology, or a related life sciences field, or an equivalent combination of education and substantial relevant experience.
Extensive experience managing or leading institutional biosafety programs in a research laboratory, biotechnology, government, or comparable environment.
Expert knowledge of biosafety principles, laboratory operations, pathogenic microbiological techniques, biological containment, and biological hazard controls.
Expert knowledge of applicable biosafety regulations, standards, and guidelines, including BMBL, NIH Guidelines, OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens requirements, and relevant DOE requirements.
Substantial experience with biosafety or voting membership in relevant biogovernance committees such as IBC, IRE, IACUC, or equivalent committees.
Demonstrated experience conducting or overseeing biological research risk assessments, laboratory inspections, audits, incident investigations, and corrective action programs.
Experience developing policies, procedures, training programs, performance measures, reports, and other institutional program documents.
Demonstrated ability to interpret highly complex or ambiguous regulatory requirements and apply them across diverse research and operational environments.
Experience managing resources, projects, priorities, budgets, or personnel within a complex organization.
Excellent communication, facilitation, collaboration, negotiation, presentation, and conflict-resolution skills.
Strong analytical, organizational, situational awareness, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Demonstrated ability to build trust, gain consensus, and influence personnel at all levels while maintaining high standards of safety and compliance.

Qualifications We Desire

Current certification or registration through the American Biological Safety Association, such as Certified Biological Safety Professional or Registered Biosafety Professional.
Experience working at the BSL-3 or ABSL-3 containment level.
Knowledge of CDC and USDA import, export, transport, and permit requirements.
Experience with biological security, biosecurity, or biological risk management.
Experience with DOE directives, orders, laboratory operating contracts, or other federal research requirements.
Experience supporting the design, commissioning, or renovation of biological research facilities.
Experience developing data-driven program metrics and communicating program performance to senior leadership.
Experience supervising, mentoring, recruiting, or developing biosafety professionals.
Experience leading biosafety programs in a national laboratory or other highly regulated research environment.

Pay Range:
$240,960- $305,544 Annually

This is the lowest to highest salary range in good faith we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Additional Information

Position Information

This is a Career Indefinite position, open to Lab employees and external candidates.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
Flexible Benefits Package
401(k)
Relocation Assistance
Education Reimbursement Program
Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs)
Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

This position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance. If you are selected, we will initiate a Federal background investigation to determine if you meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information or matter. Also, all L or Q cleared employees are subject to random drug testing. Q-level clearance requires U.S. citizenship.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

Decision Intelligence Analyst – Corporate Engineering

As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. jobs.description:
Mistplay est l'application de fidélité n°1 pour les joueurs mobiles. Notre communauté de millions de joueurs mobiles engagés utilise Mistplay pour découvrir de nouveaux jeux et gagner des récompenses. Les joueurs sont récompensés pour le temps et l'argent qu'ils consacrent aux jeux et peuvent échanger ces récompenses contre des cartes cadeaux. Mistplay a pour mission d'être le meilleur moyen de jouer à des jeux mobiles pour tous, partout dans le monde ! Téléchargez Mistplay sur le Google Play Store  ici  et suivez-nous sur  Instagram ,  Twitter  et  Facebook .

📍 Veuillez noter :
Au Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay suit un modèle hybride de 2 jours/semaine en bureau à Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montréal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

Mistplay is the #1 loyalty app for mobile gamers. Our community of millions of engaged mobile gamers come to Mistplay to discover new games to play and earn rewards. Gamers are rewarded for their time and money spent within the games and can redeem those rewards for gift cards. Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store  here  and follow us on  Instagram ,  Twitter  and  Facebook .

📍 Please Note:
In Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay follows a 2 days/week in-office hybrid model in Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montreal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

Au sein du service des données de Mistplay, l'analyste de données sénior I, Produit
 jouera un rôle crucial dans l'amélioration de la performance commerciale de Mistplay grâce à une analyse perspicace et à une stratégie d'analyse dynamique. Rattaché au Responsable de l'analyse des données et de l'expérimentation
, tu collaboreras avec les responsables des produits et du cycle de vie pour planifier et analyser les résultats des tests A/B, et tu conduiras des rapports d'analyse afin d'informer le lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités du produit et de stratégies d'engagement.

Tes missions chez Mistplay : 

Mener des analyses proactives pour identifier des informations exploitables, notamment en se plongeant dans l'entonnoir du produit de base, les cohortes d'utilisateurs et en analysant les données relatives au comportement des utilisateurs, afin d'identifier les domaines de l'expérience utilisateur qui peuvent être améliorés pour générer de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires.

Définir des ICP pour l'entreprise et construire des tableaux de bord automatisés, des rapports et des modèles pour permettre aux équipes de Mistplay de prendre de meilleures décisions.

Concevoir, coordonner et analyser les résultats d'expériences multivariées sur les produits afin de stimuler la croissance, d'améliorer les caractéristiques des produits existants et de tester de nouveaux domaines d'opportunités.

Collaborer avec les parties prenantes des données, du produit, du marketing et de l'ingénierie pour définir les problèmes commerciaux, les projets, identifier les risques et les dépendances, et créer des plans d'exécution.

Ce que tu apporteras à Mistplay :

BA/BS en informatique, mathématiques, économie, statistiques ou autres domaines quantitatifs.

4+ ans d'expérience dans l'analyse quantitative (de préférence dans l'industrie technologique) et une expérience avérée de l'impact sur les décisions relatives à l'entreprise ou au produit.

Capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des concepts et des analyses complexes de manière simple et facile à comprendre, à un large éventail de publics techniques et non techniques.

Expérience des tests A/B et solides connaissances de base des concepts de statistiques inférentielles (signification, puissance, intervalles de confiance, variance, etc.)

Maîtrise du langage SQL. Expérience de l'extraction de données complexes et hautement dimensionnelles, ainsi que de la modélisation de scénarios et de l'analyse de sensibilité à l'aide d'Excel.

Expérience de Python ou d'un autre outil de programmation pour la modélisation statistique

Familiarité avec Tableau ou tout autre outil de BI 

Familiarité avec les technologies de données en nuage telles que AWS, Azure ou Databricks pour interroger et construire des modèles de données et des rapports. 

Une attitude positive et une bonne dose de curiosité naturelle. Il faut répondre aux questions et nos données ne vont pas s'analyser toutes seules. (Nous y travaillons.)

Un atout si tu as... :

Une passion pour les jeux et une bonne connaissance de l'industrie du jeu.

Une compréhension de la science des données et des techniques d'apprentissage automatique

Une expérience du travail avec de très grands ensembles de données et de l'informatique distribuée (Hive/Hadoop).

Nous travaillons dur pour rendre notre environnement de travail aussi accueillant et plaisant que possible ! Un poste chez Mistplay s’accompagne de toute une série d'avantages que nous proposons en mode virtuel ou présentiel : Dîners d'équipe, soirées jeux, événements à l'échelle de l'entreprise, et bien plus encore.

Notre culture est profondément ancrée dans la croissance et soutenue par une équipe de personnes intelligentes, dynamiques et enthousiastes. Nous utilisons les données pour apprendre, améliorer et adapter en permanence. Nous favorisons un environnement dans lequel chacun est encouragé à partager ses idées, à repousser les limites, à prendre des risques calculés et à voir ses visions se concrétiser.

Tu penses que tu as ce qu'il faut ? Nous aimerions te rencontrer !

Senior Data Analyst I, Product

The Senior Data Analyst I, Product  within Mistplay's Data department will play a crucial role in enhancing Mistplay's business performance through insightful analysis and driving analytics strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Data Analytics & Experimentation, you will collaborate with Product & Lifecycle Managers to plan and analyze the results of A/B tests, and drive insights reporting in order to inform the release of new product features and engagement strategies.

What You'll Be Doing:

Conduct proactive analysis to identify actionable insights, including diving into the core product funnel, user cohorts, and analyzing user behaviour data, in order to identify areas of the user experience that can be improved to drive new business opportunities.

Define KPIs for the company and build automated dashboards, reports, and models to enable teams at Mistplay to make better decisions.

Design, orchestrate, and analyze the results of multivariate product experiments to help drive growth, improve existing product features, and test new areas of opportunity.

Collaborate with data, product, marketing, and engineering stakeholders to define business problems, scope out projects, identify risks and dependencies, and create execution plans.

What We're Looking For:

BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields

4+ years of work experience doing quantitative analysis (preferably in the tech industry) and a proven track record of impacting a business or product decisions

Pro-level ability to synthesize and communicate complex concepts and analyses in simple, easy-to-understand ways, to a wide range of technical and non-technical audiences

Past experience in A/B testing, and a strong foundational knowledge of core inferential statistics concepts (significance, power, confidence intervals, variance, etc.)

Fluency in SQL. Experience pulling highly dimensional and complex data, as well as modeling scenarios and sensitivity analysis using Excel

Experience with Python or another programming tool for statistical modeling

Familiarity with Tableau or any BI tool 

Familiarity with cloud data technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Databricks to query and build data models and reports 

Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)

Bonus if you have:

A love of gaming and familiarity with the games industry

Understanding of data science and machine learning techniques

Experience working with very large data sets and distributed computing (Hive/Hadoop)

Estimated Starting Salary Range for Engineering Project Manager
: Up to $140,000

Pay commensurate with experience.

Full time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.

Work closely with the Contracting Officer Representative (COR) and AFIMSC Det 2 client to provide technical advice and project management support for the FSRM and MILCON Programs.
In concert with the COR and Det 2 client, develop a plan for overseeing the FSRM and MILCON Program and project management in collaboration with HQ PACAF/A4C.
Participate in regular meetings with all stakeholders, coordinating FSRM and MILCON related travel, and reviewing program/project deliverables.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Role:

Project Manager, Client Delivery

Superpower:

Project Orchestrator

Above The Fray is seeking a Project Manager, Client Delivery to join our Client Services team.
This is a hands-on, client-facing role responsible for keeping assigned digital commerce accounts organized, financially visible, clearly communicated, and moving forward.

The Project Manager serves as the operational counterpart to ATF’s technical and delivery leaders. While subject matter experts focus on strategy, solutions, and execution, this person maintains command of the project plan, budget, communication, decisions, commitments, and follow-through.

This is not a department leadership role. It is a working project management position for someone who enjoys being close to clients, teams, numbers, and day-to-day delivery.

Who You Are

You notice what needs to be done and act. You keep the right people informed, but you do not wait to be asked or use communication as a substitute for action.

You raise concerns early and constructively, focusing on solutions rather than blame. You treat feedback as useful information, give it respectfully, and receive it without defensiveness.

People trust you because you follow through. You do what you said you would do, when you said you would do it, and exceed the quality expected. When projects become pressured or unclear, you remain calm, direct, and easy to work alongside.

You are comfortable working in the details while maintaining awareness of the broader client relationship, financial position, and delivery objective.

What You Will Own

Client Delivery and Communication

You will be the day-to-day operational lead for assigned accounts. You will understand what the client is trying to accomplish, keep communication moving, and make sure conversations turn into clear decisions and action.
Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned clients.
Maintain awareness of client priorities, concerns, decisions, and commitments.
Respond promptly and ensure requests are acknowledged, assigned, and followed through.
Build trust through preparation, transparency, responsiveness, and consistency.
Participate in discovery sessions, planning meetings, business reviews, onsite engagements, and industry events as needed.
Communicate delivery risks, dependencies, budget constraints, and required tradeoffs clearly.

Project Operations and Financial Visibility

You will maintain an accurate view of how each project is performing and surface issues before they become emergencies.
Track project financials, working hours, burn rates, milestones, forecasts, and team capacity.
Monitor account staffing allocations and analyze how resource levels affect project budgets and delivery.
Flag budget overages, underutilization, time-tracking errors, forecast variances, and scope risks for team review.
Work with finance, operations, and delivery leaders to investigate discrepancies and prepare clear explanations.
Support prioritization, downscoping, and change-management discussions when requested work exceeds available budget.
Provide concise reporting on budget position, forecast, staffing impact, and emerging financial risks.

Planning, Coordination, and Follow-Through

You will create the structure that allows clients and delivery teams to move efficiently.
Own project plans, milestones, dependencies, action items, and delivery calendars.
Maintain the backlog and sprint board in close partnership with technical and client leads, ensuring work is prioritized, sufficiently defined, assigned, and ready to move forward.
Coordinate with Technical Architects, squad leads, engineers, designers, QA, marketing specialists, and other contributors.
Ensure teams have the information, access, approvals, and client input required to complete their work.
Organize planning sessions, demos, backlog reviews, and other delivery meetings appropriate to the account.
Ensure each meeting results in clear decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and documented follow-through.
Surface blockers and unresolved decisions before they affect delivery.
Maintain the project’s decisions, risks, commitments, action items, and delivery status, coordinating with technical leads on technical documentation.
Maintain ticket hygiene by ensuring all work is assigned through properly written tickets with clear scope, description, and acceptance criteria.

What Success Looks Like

Clients receive timely, clear communication and understand what happens next.
Budgets, staffing concerns, scope risks, and delivery issues are surfaced early.
Project plans, boards, forecasts, action logs, and ownership remain current and reliable.
Meetings produce decisions and action rather than additional ambiguity.
Technical and delivery leaders can focus on their areas of expertise without repeatedly chasing administrative follow-up.
Assigned accounts become more organized, predictable, and financially healthy.
Clients and teammates view you as dependable, constructive, and easy to work with under pressure.

Qualifications

Approximately 3 to 5 years of project management, client delivery, account coordination, or related experience.
Experience in an agency, consultancy, software company, ecommerce business, or another client-service environment.
Experience coordinating digital, ecommerce, website, software, or technical projects.
Demonstrated responsibility for budgets, schedules, client communication, project reporting, or resource coordination.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain awareness across several active accounts.
Comfort working with project financials, forecasts, staffing allocations, and delivery reporting.
Ability to turn conversations into clear decisions, actions, owners, and deadlines.
Strong client-facing written and verbal communication.
Ability to identify risks, gaps, and inconsistencies without waiting for someone else to raise them.
Experience working with distributed or international teams is helpful.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Tempo, Slack, Google Workspace, and major ecommerce platforms is beneficial but not required.

Reporting Structure

Reports to:
Client Services leadership, working closely with ATF’s technical and delivery leaders.

Direct reports:
None currently. The role may provide day-to-day guidance and support to project coordinators or other delivery support roles.

Why Above The Fray?

We are driven by our simple, straightforward aim; Make it Better.
Ideal candidates will embrace and live this ethos in their everyday interactions and activity.
Work with the best. Every team member at ATF raises the bar for each other. A wide array of skill sets and talents, all at the top of their game. Expect to grow, and to promote the growth of others.
We own our work. Things don’t always go perfectly in custom software development, but leadership will have your back and fight for the success of both the ATF team and our clients.
We really enjoy problem-solving together. As the climate allows, we regularly have team celebrations and company events. Happy hours, potlucks, company retreats, and international travel opportunities.
Flourishing platform partnerships with folks like Adobe, Magento, BigCommerce, Shopware, and many more staple companies in the digital commerce universe.
Unique opportunities for skill development and professional growth.
Be a part of something bigger than the sum of our parts. Being a contributing member of our community means we think beyond the confines of our business, and support the environment that props us up.
